categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Songyuan Automotive Safety Systems Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, design, production, sales, and service of automotive passive safety system products including automotive seat belt assemblies, airbags, steering wheels, and special seat safety devices. The company is a leading domestic Tier 1 supplier in the automotive passive safety system sector and is expanding into vehicle safety control modules and intelligent integrated solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in seat belt pre-tensioning, force limiting, and emergency locking mechanisms, as well as multi-functional airbags and steering wheels. It employs advanced CAE simulation, system integration, and automated assembly lines with international-level equipment. The company has developed in-house production capabilities for key components such as safety belt webbing and airbag fabrics, enhancing product profitability and rapid development adaptability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and joint-venture automotive manufacturers such as Geely, SAIC-GM-Wuling, Great Wall Motors, Chery, Changan, Yutong Bus, BAIC Foton, FAW-Volkswagen, SAIC Volkswagen, Anhui Volkswagen, Stellantis, Dongfeng Motor, GAC, BYD, NIO, Li Auto, XPeng, Leapmotor, Audi, and others. The products serve passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, new energy vehicles, and special vehicles, with a strong focus on the domestic Chinese market and growing international presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, and expanding production facilities in Anhui Province. It has established overseas subsidiaries in Germany, Singapore, and Malaysia to support international market development and R&D activities. Domestic sales account for over 93% of revenue, with exports comprising about 6-7%.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Songyuan operates as an upstream Tier 1 supplier in the automotive supply chain, directly supplying automotive OEMs with critical passive safety components. The company is extending its upstream integration by increasing self-manufacturing of key raw materials and components to enhance cost control and supply chain responsiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in intelligent and integrated passive safety systems, including smart pre-tensioning seat belts, advanced airbags with active venting, damping steering wheels for new energy vehicles, and integrated control modules. It focuses on breaking foreign technology monopolies through independent innovation, expanding product portfolios, and enhancing electronic and electrical architecture capabilities to support intelligent driving and smart cockpit systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive passive safety system products to OEMs under long-term supply contracts. Pricing is based on cost-plus models with negotiated annual purchase agreements. The company also engages in export sales and provides after-sales services, with revenue recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global automotive passive safety system market is dominated by a few foreign giants, but Zhejiang Songyuan has established itself as a leading domestic player with growing market share. It competes by leveraging cost advantages, rapid customization, and integrated system solutions to achieve import substitution and expand into joint venture and foreign OEM supply chains. The company is recognized as a domestic industry leader and actively participates in industry standard setting.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.97 billion, a 53.94% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 260 million, up 31.65%. Total assets reached RMB 3.14 billion, growing 58.33% from the prior year. The company has demonstrated strong growth momentum supported by capacity expansion, increased R&D spending, and successful market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Songyuan emphasizes high safety performance, innovation-driven product upgrades, and cost-effective solutions tailored to customer needs. Its unique value lies in providing full-chain autonomous passive safety system solutions with rapid response capabilities, high product quality, and integration of intelligent features. The company’s ability to break foreign technology monopolies and deliver customized, high-value products supports its competitive differentiation and leadership in the domestic market.
